in_english.name: Tamayyuz
in_english.long_meaning: Tamayyuz is an Arabic name that means discernment, kindness, and pleasant disposition. The name is derived from the Arabic root 't-m-y-z', which conveys the idea of distinguishing between good and evil, and the Quranic verse 6:165, which emphasizes the importance of discernment in making decisions. In Islamic tradition, Tamayyuz is considered a positive trait, associated with wisdom, justice, and compassion. The name is also associated with the qualities of being fair-minded, empathetic, and kind-hearted. In modern times, the name has gained popularity across various Muslim cultures, and is often given to children born into families that value these qualities
